fields.zileDisponibileAnCurent: Initial available balance from current year
fields.drepturiAfectate: Annual grants whose date would change

messages.profilSalvat: The leave profile has been saved.
messages.corectieProgramAcordareSalvata: The next grant date was corrected and recorded in history.
messages.corectieProgramAcordareInvalida: Choose a different date and enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.confirmareCorectieProgramAcordare: The correction can only change unused future entitlements. Approved requests and historical documents will not be recalculated. Continue?
messages.programAcordarePoateFiCorectat: The change is allowed. Only unused future entitlements will be updated; historical requests and documents remain unchanged.
messages.dataAcordareTrebuieViitoare: The change is blocked: the new grant date must be later than today.
messages.dataAcordareNeschimbata: The change is blocked: the new date is identical to the existing date.
messages.anAcordareDiferit: The change is blocked: the correction must remain in the same calendar year. Changing the year requires a separate administrative operation.
messages.programAcordareFolositDeCereri: The change is blocked because a future annual entitlement is already reserved or consumed by the requests listed below. They must be rejected or cancelled before correction.
messages.programAcordareDataInvalida: The change is blocked: the new month and day do not form a valid date for one of the future entitlements.
messages.corectieSoldSalvata: The balance correction was saved and recorded in history.
messages.corectieSoldInvalida: Enter a non-zero whole-number difference and a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.corectieSoldPesteDisponibil: Cannot subtract {scadere} days; the available balance is {disponibile}.
messages.explicatieInitializare: Annual entitlement defines how many days will be granted on the next grant date. Initial balance is the real number of current-year days available now; no historical usage is inferred. Remaining days from the previous year are entered separately and used first.
messages.explicatieDreptAnual: Days added at every future annual grant. This is not the number of days already used.
messages.explicatieSoldCurent: Days from the current-year entitlement that are still available today.
messages.explicatieSoldReportat: Unused days carried over from earlier years. The oldest days are consumed first.
messages.explicatieDataAcordare: The date when the next annual entitlement will be added automatically.
messages.explicatieProfilInitializat: The profile is active. Available balances are calculated from the ledger and are read-only here; only the future annual entitlement can be saved directly.
messages.explicatieProfilNeinitializat: Enter the real balances available today and a future grant date, then initialize the profile once.
messages.explicatieCorectiiAdministrative: Use only to repair an incorrect grant schedule or balance. Every correction requires a reason and is recorded in the ledger.
messages.explicatieCorectieProgram: Changes the date of the next annual grant and reschedules only unused future grants. Approved requests and documents already generated remain unchanged.
messages.explicatieCorectieSold: Adds or removes whole days from the available balance. The configured annual entitlement remains unchanged.
messages.explicatieDrepturiAfectate: This is the number of scheduled annual grant records whose date would change, not the number of leave requests.
messages.zileDisponibilePesteDrept: The initial current-year balance cannot exceed the configured annual entitlement.
messages.dataUrmatoareiAcordariTrebuieViitoare: The next grant date must be later than today. Days currently available must be entered in the initial balance.
messages.profilConcediuExistent: The employee has an existing leave profile.
messages.profilConcediuNeinitializat: The leave profile is not initialized.
